decisions.title: Diagram notation for the suite
decisions.context: Option A (recommended): Mermaid fences in Markdown, conservative profile pinned to GitHub's Mermaid 11.17.2, headless parse gate. Option B: D2 source with committed SVG/ASCII renders. Evidence: docs/reference/state-of-the-art-in-diagramming-for-agent-written-docs.md. ADR: docs/adr/0001-use-mermaid-in-markdown-as-the-diagram-notation.md
decisions.outcome: Option A: Mermaid fences in Markdown, conservative profile, headless parse gate pinned to GitHub's Mermaid (11.17.2 on 2026-10-05). Chosen by the owner 2026-10-05.

decisions.title: Suite shape: six focused skills
decisions.context: Option A (recommended): lean 4 skills (diagram, diagram-architecture, diagram-plan, diagram-review). Option B: fuller 6 skills (architecture, process, decision, plan, data, review). Design: docs/specs/diagram-skill-suite-design.md
decisions.outcome: Option B chosen by the owner 2026-10-05: diagram-architecture, diagram-process, diagram-decision, diagram-plan, diagram-data, diagram-review, sharing one engine under diagram-review.
